clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, Gilshalan Windwalker seeks an unhatched Webwood Egg for his study of Teldrassil’s wildlife. After gathering venom samples, he needs a living specimen to examine the unnatural aggression afflicting the forest’s creatures. An egg can be studied safely without subduing a full-grown spider.

Gilshalan Windwalker needs live subjects to understand the unnatural corruption affecting the Webwood spiders around Shadowglen. You have secured raw venom from the aggressive spiders, but carrying a thrashing giant out of the depths would be deadly for a novice. Gilshalan asks you to bring back an unhatched egg from the brooding clutches inside Shadowthread Cave.

Webwood spiders brood in Shadowthread Cave, where the forest’s increasingly hostile arachnids make their nests. An intact egg gives scholars a controlled subject that can hatch under containment. Gilshalan plans to bundle it with his venom samples and send both to Darnassus for examination. With his local study complete, he directs recruits toward higher duties in the boughs of Aldrassil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that I have the spiders' venom, I'd like some live specimens to study. Unfortunately, capturing a living, giant spider is more than I can ask of you, young hunter. And a giant spider is more than I could handle myself!
But if you can find an unhatched egg, then delivering specimens will be much easier, and I can then arrange for the unhatched spiders to be contained.
There must be a nest deep in the Shadowthread Cave. Please, search for an egg in the nest and return it to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been inside the Shadowthread Cave, friend? Did you find a spider egg?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, very good. I will have this egg and the venom transported to Darnassus, then return there when my studies are done here. I expect to find out a great deal from these specimens, friend. You have been a great help to me.
